Description: Our goal is to provide therapeutic sports massage by certified CAMCT practitioners. One main focus of our practice will the relief and management of pain, muscular tension and injuries associated with sports practice, accidents, over use, bad posture and so on. By means of muscle balance and structural integration, we will strive to achieve better physical function in order to improve the daily life and athletic performance of our clients. This would be a husband and wife run business. We have about 50 years of combined experience as certified massage therapist and it would be a great pleasure to serve our community here in Berkeley, where we have resided for nearly 30 years!
